title: af/telemetry-tail@1
description: One line of `af telemetry tail --json` (design §10; ADR-0153): a span end or an event as its writer wrote it to a live segment, with the segment and the record's `seq`, the span (its name; for an event, the span it is on), the run's `trace_id` when the span belongs to one, the time as unix nanoseconds in a decimal string, a span end's duration in microseconds (when its start was read) and status, and the record's attributes as written. While a run is open a record reaches the segment within `[telemetry] flush_latency_ms` of its creation.
